mapper.select: SELECT id, name, path, icon, intro, target_json, min_ability, min_academic, learning_json, abilities_json, courses_json, activities_json, path_desc_json, misconceptions_json, sort_order, applicable_majors_json, status, updated, created_at, updated_at, deleted FROM career_direction WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO career_direction (id, name, path, icon, intro, target_json, min_ability, min_academic, learning_json, abilities_json, courses_json, activities_json, path_desc_json, misconceptions_json, sort_order, applicable_majors_json, status, updated) VALUES (#{id}, #{name}, #{path}, #{icon}, #{intro}, #{targetJson}, #{minAbility}, #{minAcademic}, #{learningJson}, #{abilitiesJson}, #{coursesJson}, #{activitiesJson}, #{pathDescJson}, #{misconceptionsJson}, #{sortOrder}, #{applicableMajorsJson}, #{status}, #{updated})
mapper.update: UPDATE career_direction SET name = #{name}, path = #{path}, icon = #{icon}, intro = #{intro}, target_json = #{targetJson}, min_ability = #{minAbility}, min_academic = #{minAcademic}, learning_json = #{learningJson}, abilities_json = #{abilitiesJson}, courses_json = #{coursesJson}, activities_json = #{activitiesJson}, path_desc_json = #{pathDescJson}, misconceptions_json = #{misconceptionsJson}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, applicable_majors_json = #{applicableMajorsJson}, updated = #{updated}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
